rows.head: THE CONTINENT'S CROWN
rows.text: {manager} has the continent's top prize under glass now, and {club} will polish it every morning.

rows.head: TOP SHELF TENANT
rows.text: The biggest trophy in the building has found its home, and {manager} has placed it on the top shelf with care.

rows.head: THE UPPER CASE
rows.text: {club} needed a bigger key for this prize, because the continental crown would not fit in any ordinary cupboard.

rows.head: THE ENGRAVER'S BEST LETTERING
rows.text: The engraver has been working through the night on the continental inscription, and {manager} wants every letter to shine.

rows.head: CONTINENTAL MEDAL
rows.text: {club} now hold the medal that matters most across the continent, and the ribbon has been pressed flat by a proud hand.

rows.head: A FINER PLACE
rows.text: Nobody on the continent has a finer place on the display than {manager}, whose crown now sits above every other silver piece.

rows.head: KEY TO THE CASE
rows.text: Hand over the key, {manager}, because the continental prize is ready for its spotlight, and the glass has never looked so bright.

rows.head: SILVER FOR THE CONTINENT
rows.text: {club} have carried the continent's top silver home, and the case is already too small for the kind of glory on show.

rows.head: POLISH THE CROWN AGAIN
rows.text: The crown needs a polish before the photographers arrive, so {manager} has gathered the cloths and started on the big gold piece.

rows.head: THE RECORD BOOKS
rows.text: Under the lights, {club} lifted the continent's most famous prize, and the history books will need a fresh page for {manager}.

rows.head: THE CROWN COMES HOME
rows.text: The continental crown has come home to {club}, and {manager} has given it the proudest spot on the sideboard, facing the door.

rows.head: THE LOCK CLICKS SHUT
rows.text: The lock clicks shut on the top case, and {manager} keeps the only key on a ribbon round the neck.

rows.head: EUROPE'S PRIZE, ENGRAVED
rows.text: A plate with the continent's name is being engraved right now, and {club} will have their own letters beside the glass soon.

rows.head: HOME AT LAST
rows.text: {manager} carried the grandest trophy in club football to the top of the stairs and set it down in the best case in the house.

rows.head: CROWNED FOR THE CONTINENT
rows.text: Few silver pieces on the continent shine like this, and {club} have bought the finest polish in town to keep it that way.

rows.head: A NEW SHELF
rows.text: The Europa silver has its own shelf, polished to a shine, and {manager} has promised it will never sit in the dark.

rows.head: A BIGGER SMILE
rows.text: It may not be the continent's top prize, but {club} have given it a glass case, a velvet cloth and a spot near the door.

rows.head: THE OTHER CROWN
rows.text: {manager} lifted the continent's other prize with the same care given to any silver in the room, and the ribbon looks finer for it.

rows.head: A SMALLER PLATE, ENGRAVED
rows.text: The engraver is cutting the name of {club} onto the modest plate, and the letters are so crisp they could slice glass.

rows.head: WORTH THE POLISH
rows.text: Every cloth in the house has been used on this prize, and {manager} still finds a fresh smudge to wipe away each evening.

rows.head: THE SHELF FILLS UP
rows.text: Once the shelf held nothing but dust, and now {club} have a European prize standing in front of the old silver with pride.

rows.head: A KEY TURNS
rows.text: {manager} turned the key on the European case with a flourish, then tucked the spare into a waistcoat pocket for safekeeping.

rows.head: SIDE ROOM RIBBONS
rows.text: The ribbons are pressed, the plate is shining, and {club} have given the smaller silver a corner of its own in the trophy room.

rows.head: A NEW TENANT
rows.text: A new tenant has moved into the glass case, and {manager} has promised the lodger a clean window, good light and steady polishing.

rows.head: EARNS ITS PLACE
rows.text: Some prizes take a long road to the shelf, and {club} earned this continental piece the hard way, through every round.

rows.head: MEDAL AND MEMORY
rows.text: The medal is pinned to velvet, the case is wiped, and {manager} is already picturing the week the trophy goes on show.

rows.head: PROUDLY POLISHED
rows.text: {club} have the polish out again, rubbing the continental prize until the engraving catches the light across the whole room.

rows.head: A FINAL TOUCH
rows.text: Before the case closes for the evening, {manager} adds a last touch of silver to the shelf, a small piece that has been waiting.

rows.head: THE SIDE SHELF GLOWS
rows.text: On the side shelf, {club} have a European prize glowing under the lamp, and visitors are asked to admire it without fingerprints.

rows.head: THE LEAGUE'S PRIZE
rows.text: The title has been wrapped in tissue and placed in the cabinet, where {manager} can admire its tarnish-free shine every morning.

rows.head: THE TABLE SPEAKS
rows.text: Look at the league table, with {club} at the very top, the ink is dry and the title belongs to {manager} once more.

rows.head: A LEAGUE SHIELD
rows.text: {club} have a league shield with fresh engraving, and the lettering is sharp enough to read from the far end of the shelf.

rows.head: TITLE AT THE CENTRE
rows.text: The league crown sits in the centre of the cabinet now, and {manager} has rubbed it until the reflection is just right.

rows.head: THE LEDGER IS BALANCED
rows.text: Every column of the season's ledger now adds up to the title for {club}, and the figures are polished like silver.

rows.head: A LONG ROAD
rows.text: The league is a long road of matches, but the title at the end of it is a gleaming piece that {manager} can lift.

rows.head: THE CABINET KEY
rows.text: The key to the league drawer is with {manager}, and the title medal sits in a velvet slot where the light always finds it.

rows.head: TOP OF THE TABLE
rows.text: A top-of-the-table finish deserves a top-of-the-shelf display, and {club} have found the spot right above the glass.

rows.head: LEAGUE PLATE READY
rows.text: The plate for the league title is ready for the wall, and {manager} is checking that every letter of {club} is spelled right.

rows.head: BALANCING THE BOOKS
rows.text: {club} have balanced the books for the whole season, and the league trophy sits in the case like the final figure on a total.

rows.head: BEHIND THE GLASS
rows.text: Behind the glass the league title gleams, and {manager} can see the reflection of the whole table in its polished surface.

rows.head: RIBBON AT THE FINISH
rows.text: Over a marathon of matches, {manager} crossed the line with the title ribbon crisp at the finish.

rows.head: A SEASON ADDS UP
rows.text: Sheet by sheet the season adds up in {club}'s favour, and the title goes into the cabinet with a neat little bow.

rows.head: POLISHING CLOTH OVERTIME
rows.text: {manager} has worked the polishing cloth over the league title until the shine could be seen from the back of the room.

rows.head: LEAGUE SILVER
rows.text: Season after season, {club} have been circling this shelf, and now the league title finally has a spot worth its weight.

rows.head: A CUP WITH HANDLES
rows.text: The cup has handles on both sides to polish, and {manager} is working through them with a clean cloth and a serious face.

rows.head: KNOCKOUT ON THE SHELF
rows.text: Round after round of knockout football ended with this cup in the hands of {club}, and it now gleams on the middle shelf.

rows.head: WORTH A DETOUR
rows.text: Some managers chase the cup like a late train, but {manager} caught it in plenty of time and laid it out for the display.

rows.head: ROUND BY ROUND
rows.text: The road to the cup is paved with tough draws and tighter ties, and {club} walked it with a kit bag full of nerve.

rows.head: THE HANDLE SHINES
rows.text: {manager} has given the handle of the cup a fine polish, and the glass case looks brighter than it has in years.

rows.head: CENTRE STAGE
rows.text: Put the cup centre stage, because the knockout silver has finally found a home that suits its size and its story.

rows.head: THE CORNER SHINES
rows.text: The cup sits quietly in the corner of the room, but {club} have buffed it until the whole corner glows like a spotlight.

rows.head: THE KNOCKOUT ENGRAVING
rows.text: Engraved with the rounds that carried {club} through, the cup now tells the story of {manager}'s road in small, shining letters.

rows.head: BEAMING BY THE LAMP
rows.text: The handle is warm from handling, the engraving is sharp, and {manager} is beaming like a lamp left on all night.

rows.head: CUP IN THE DRAWER
rows.text: {club} have locked the cup in the drawer for the night, but the handle sticks out just enough to catch the light.

rows.head: THE HARD WAY
rows.text: Cup football is unforgiving, but {manager} kept winning the difficult ties, and the cup now sits proudly beside the league shield.

rows.head: THE DUSTER RESTS
rows.text: For once the duster can rest, because the cup of {club} has been wiped clean and placed back on the shelf with a nod.

rows.head: A SILVER LINING
rows.text: Every cup has a silver lining, and {manager} has picked the brightest corner of the room to show it off.

rows.head: THE KNOCKOUT ENDS
rows.text: The knockout run is over, the last tie is a memory, and {club} have a cup to show for every nervy moment on the way.

rows.head: A BADGE FOR DIGNITY
rows.text: A small badge for the top performance has been pinned to the velvet, and {manager} is pleased with the neat little tribute.

rows.head: STEADY FORM RIBBON
rows.text: No cup this time, but the steady form earned a ribbon, and {club} have pinned it neatly to the lid of the display case.

rows.head: A BIG SMILE
rows.text: The performance medal is small enough to fit in a waistcoat pocket, but {manager} has made sure it sits with the main silver.

rows.head: THE BONUS SHINES ANYWAY
rows.text: It is only a bonus, but {manager} has buffed it so hard that it catches the lamp from the far side of the room.

rows.head: GOOD FORM PLATE
rows.text: The little plate reads well, the lettering is clean, and {club} can point to it whenever a guest asks about the form.

rows.head: NOT A CROWN
rows.text: Not a cup and not a crown, just a sensible bonus for a sturdy campaign, and {manager} has put it right by the keys.

rows.head: A SLIP OF PAPER
rows.text: The slip of paper in the case thanks {manager} for consistency, with a little gold border that matches the rest of the set.

rows.head: THE EXTRA MEDAL GLEAMS
rows.text: An extra medal gleams on the lower tier of the display, and {club} hold it up to the lamp to admire every ridge.

rows.head: A BRIGHT FINISH
rows.text: {manager} earned the bonus with patience, polish and a bright finish, and the small plate now sits smartly beside the keys.

rows.head: A STEADY HAND
rows.text: A steady hand on the tiller earned the badge, and {manager} has decided it belongs in the front pane of the cabinet.

rows.head: A TOUCH OF GOLD
rows.text: Hard work deserves a touch of gold, and {manager} has added a small gilded label to the bonus badge on the shelf.

rows.head: GLOW ON THE BADGE
rows.text: A ribbon this small still catches the eye, and {club} have arranged it so the glow falls on the badge from every angle.

rows.head: POLISHED FOR THE PERFORMANCE
rows.text: Good form deserves a proper plate, so {manager} has asked for the performance bonus to be engraved, buffed and placed in the case.

rows.head: TURNS HEADS
rows.text: The bonus is never the main event, but this little badge turns heads when the lamp catches it, and {manager} knows it.

rows.head: THE BOSS'S PLAQUE
rows.text: The honours plaque has been hung beside the cabinet, and {manager} has been asked to look at it every morning for a while.

rows.head: THE HONOURS BOARD GROWS
rows.text: A fresh name goes on the honours board, in gold leaf, and {manager} has asked the carpenter for a little more room.

rows.head: BRIGHT ENGRAVING
rows.text: An individual honour does not need a crown, only a clean plaque and a good light, and {club} have both ready for it.

rows.head: A CERTIFICATE
rows.text: The certificate is folded neatly into a velvet sleeve, and {manager} is said to read it aloud whenever the lights go down.

rows.head: AN ENCORE
rows.text: The applause has been written up neatly, and {manager} has the honour framed like an encore that refuses to end.

rows.head: A SOLO HONOUR SHINES
rows.text: An honour for the manager alone sits apart from the silver, and {manager} keeps the glass case polished so it stands out.

rows.head: THE MANAGER'S OWN SHELF
rows.text: Some honours belong to the team and some belong to the boss, and {club} have given this prize its own small shelf.

rows.head: DUSTING THE PLAQUE
rows.text: A quick dusting each week keeps the plaque bright, and {manager} insists the duster is handled with the greatest respect.

rows.head: THE GOLDEN ENVELOPE OPENS
rows.text: Inside the envelope sits a little card of praise, and {manager} reads it with the same care as a letter from an old friend.

rows.head: FINE WORK FRAMED
rows.text: The frame is lightly gilded, the wording is kind, and {club} have hung the honour where {manager} will see it on the way out.

rows.head: FROM THE JURY
rows.text: The panel of judges has spoken, the gold letters have been pressed, and {manager} is pleased to be holding the honour today.

rows.head: EXTRA PRAISE, EXTRA POLISH
rows.text: Extra praise calls for extra polish, so {manager} has gone round the honours with a soft cloth and the sharpest of eyes.

rows.head: AN HONOUR ON VELVET
rows.text: The honour sits on velvet with the light turned low, and {club} are proud that the award has found a home so fitting.

rows.head: STARLIGHT HONOUR
rows.text: Like a star on a late night sky, the individual honour catches the eye, and {manager} is glad to be looking up at it.

rows.head: THE SHELVES ARE BARE
rows.text: No silver this season, so {manager} has wiped the empty shelves, kept the glass clean and left a light on for the next visit.

rows.head: NOTHING TO POLISH YET
rows.text: The case is empty for now, but {club} have bought a fresh cloth, and the cabinet is ready for the next season's gleam.

rows.head: A WAITING HOOK
rows.text: Every hook on the back wall is bare, yet {manager} still greets each hook with a nod, like an old friend in a hall.

rows.head: THE KEYS HANG UNUSED
rows.text: The keys still hang by the door, though the locks have nothing to protect this season, and {manager} keeps them shining anyway.

rows.head: QUIET ON DISPLAY
rows.text: A quiet season leaves the display case open to the air, and {club} have decided that silence can still look elegant in glass.

rows.head: DUST, BUT NO DISGRACE
rows.text: There is a little dust on the shelf and no cup to show, but {manager} says an empty case is only a case waiting.

rows.head: THE LAMP STAYS ON
rows.text: The lamp is still on over the empty glass, because {manager} believes the next season will need a brighter place to shine.

rows.head: A BLANK ENGRAVING PLATE
rows.text: The engraving plate has been polished and left blank, which means {club} are keeping the space for something worth the wait.

rows.head: THE SILENCE HOLDS
rows.text: A silence sits in the cabinet this season, and {manager} has learned to listen to it, because empty shelves can teach a lot.

rows.head: LONG QUIET NIGHTS
rows.text: Some nights are long and quiet, and this season's bare shelves are a reminder that the late nights of the next campaign matter.

rows.head: THE DOOR CLICKS SHUT
rows.text: The glass door clicks shut on a bare display, and {manager} turns the key with a grin, knowing the next season has room for silver.

rows.head: THE ROOM WAITS PATIENTLY
rows.text: The trophy room waits patiently, the stools are pushed back, and {club} have set the lamp low until the next campaign returns.

rows.head: NO SILVER, NO SHAME
rows.text: Nothing won this time, no shame either, and {manager} still polishes the empty display because the case deserves respect.

rows.head: THE SHELF WAITS
rows.text: The shelf stays clear and ready, and {manager} has put a brass sign on the front that says the next season will fill it.
